title: Ethernet II frame
summary: An Ethernet II (DIX) frame: 6-byte destination MAC, 6-byte source MAC, 2-byte EtherType, payload (46-1500 bytes), and a 4-byte FCS (CRC-32).

ext.summary: An Ethernet II (DIX) frame: 6-byte destination MAC, 6-byte source MAC, 2-byte EtherType, payload (46-1500 bytes), and a 4-byte FCS (CRC-32).

structure.meaning: Payload protocol: 0x0800 IPv4, 0x0806 ARP, 0x86DD IPv6, 0x8100 VLAN tag, ... (values >= 0x0600).
Upper-layer data; padded to 46 bytes minimum.

ext.example_hex: ff ff ff ff ff ff 00 11 22 33 44 55 08 00
notes: Minimum frame (without FCS) is 64 bytes; max 1518 (1522 with VLAN).
802.1Q inserts a 4-byte VLAN tag (TPID 0x8100) between src and EtherType.
Jumbo frames extend payload up to 9000+ bytes.
FCS is appended by the NIC and not part of the software-visible frame on receive.
